name: onemessagebus-visual-docs
//: No format-check, lint, typecheck, test, doc or check target, and that is the point: screenshots are informational, so nothing this project owns is reachable from `just check`, `just gate` or ci.yml's gate job (screenshots/AGENTS.md). The one target is `bootstrap`, which activates the committed pre-push guard — the local half of the strict gate — so `just bootstrap` leaves a clean clone guarded.
